content.text: {"story":{"as_a":"user","i_want":"edit an existing task","so_that":"I can correct its title or Due Date after it is created","business_description":"Lets a user change the title and Due Date of an existing task through an edit form. The backend validates the change and the frontend reports the result.","business_value":"Users can fix mistakes in a task without deleting and recreating it.","acceptance_criteria":[{"given":"an existing task with a valid title and a Due Date not earlier than its Creation Date","when":"the user opens the edit form, changes the title, and submits the form","then":"the backend stores the new title and the task shows the new title in the list after the backend returns success"},{"given":"an existing task being edited in the form","when":"the user clears the title field and submits the form","then":"the backend rejects the update, the task keeps its previous title, and an error message stating that the title is mandatory is shown"},{"given":"an existing task with Creation Date 2024-05-10","when":"the user sets the Due Date to 2024-05-09 and submits the update","then":"the backend rejects the update with a validation error, the stored Due Date is unchanged, and an error message is shown"},{"given":"an existing task with a title of 100 characters","when":"the user changes the title to 101 characters and submits the update","then":"the backend rejects the update with a validation error, the stored title is unchanged, and an error message stating that the title must be 100 characters or fewer is shown"},{"given":"a task update request where the backend returns an error","when":"the frontend receives the error response","then":"the frontend does not show the task as updated and displays an error message"},{"given":"a task update request where the backend returns success","when":"the frontend receives the success response","then":"the frontend displays a success message after the update action"},{"given":"a task ID that does not exist in the database","when":"an update request is sent for that ID","then":"the backend returns a Task Not Found error and no data is changed"}],"edge_cases":["A title of exactly 100 characters is accepted; a title of 101 characters or more is rejected.","Whether the 100-character limit counts characters after trimming leading and trailing spaces is not stated in the PRD and needs a decision."],"dependencies":[],"definition_of_done":["Update requests with an empty title are rejected and the stored title is unchanged.","Update requests with a Due Date earlier than the Creation Date are rejected and the stored Due Date is unchanged.","Update requests with a title longer than 100 characters are rejected and the stored title is unchanged.","The edit form shows the error message returned by the backend and does not show the task as updated."]},"revised_tasks":[],"added_requirements":[{"requirement_id":"R-0b1853d6","mode":"revise_existing","task_key":"BE-task-update-endpoint","task":{"key_slug":"task-update-endpoint","title":"[BE] Add update endpoint for a task by ID with validation and error responses","track":"backend","area":"backend","description":"Add an update endpoint that updates an existing task by ID. Validate that the title is non-empty, that the title is no longer than 100 characters, and that the Due Date is not earlier than the Creation Date. Return a validation error and leave stored data unchanged when validation fails. Return Task Not Found for a missing ID and use the simple error handling approach for invalid input and internal or database errors.","size":"M","consumes_api":false,"touches_db":true,"requirement_ids":["R-bc3213df","R-03df7815","R-efe1e5d4","R-244669c0","R-9dc414dc","R-0b1853d6"],"is_spike":false,"definition_of_done":["Update endpoint for a task by ID is implemented.","Empty titles are rejected and the stored title is unchanged.","Titles longer than 100 characters are rejected and the stored title is unchanged.","Due Dates earlier than the Creation Date are rejected and the stored Due Date is unchanged.","Missing task IDs return Task Not Found and no data is changed.","Error responses follow the simple error handling approach."]}}]}
